<strong>Territoires.wiki est un site qui traite des territoires, de leurs habitants et de leurs histoires.</strong>

<p>Explorez, rencontrez, c'est à vous de jouer!</p>


<div class="tw-grid">
    <div class="tw-grid-box">
        <h2>Actualités</h2>

        <div data-widget="ContentList" data-props='{
            "query": {
                "categories":["News"],
                "extracts": true,
                "limit": 5,
                "sort": "-Modification_date"
            }
        }'></div>
    </div>

    <div class="tw-grid-box">
        <h2>Agenda</h2>

        <div data-widget="ContentList" data-props='{
            "query": {
                "categories":["Events"],
                "extracts": true,
                "limit": 5,
                "sort": "-Modification_date"
            }
        }'></div>
    </div>

    <div class="tw-grid-box">
        <h2>Territoires</h2>

        <div data-widget="ContentList" data-props='{
            "query": {
                "categories":["Territory"],
                "extracts": true,
                "limit": 5,
                "sort": "?"
            }
        }'></div>
    </div>

    <div class="tw-grid-box">
        <h2>Au hasard...</h2>

        <div data-widget="ContentList" data-props='{
            "query": {
                "categories": ["Article", "Territory", "Organization", "Place", "Project", "Person"],
                "extracts": true,
                "limit": 5,
                "sort": "?"
            }
        }'></div>
    </div>
</div>

<h2>Explorez</h2>
<div data-widget="ContentMap" data-props='{
        "query": {
            "categories": ["Territory", "Organization", "Place", "Project"],
            "printouts":["coordinates=coordinates"],
            "sort": "-Modification_date",
            "filters": [
                ["coordinates", "exists"]
            ],
            "extracts": true
        },
        "autoloc": true,
        "full": true
    }'></div>
</div>



<div class="tw-grid">
    <div class="tw-grid-box">
        <h2>Catégories</h2>

        <div data-widget="ModelList" data-props='{"ns":"Category"}'></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tw-grid-box">
        <h2>Pour démarrer</h2>

        <ul>
            <li>[https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Manual:Configuration_settings Liste des paramètres de configuration]</li>
            <li>[https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Manual:FAQ Questions courantes sur MediaWiki]</li>
            <li>[https://lists.wikimedia.org/postorius/lists/mediawiki-announce.lists.wikimedia.org/ Liste de discussion sur les distributions de MediaWiki]</li>
            <li>[https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Localisation#Translation_resources Adaptez MediaWiki dans votre langue]</li>
            <li>[https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Manual:Combating_spam Apprendre comment combattre le pourriel dans votre wiki]</li>
        </ul>

    </div>
</div>
